title: European robin
blurb: The European robin, known simply as the robin or robin redbreast in the British Isles, is a small insectivorous passerine bird belonging to the Old World flycatcher family Muscicapidae.
facts: It is sedentary in the west and south of its range, and migratory in the north and east of its range where winters are harsher.
